dossier.headline: Markets brace for a December Fed rate hike
dossier.summary: Minutes of the Fed's October meeting showed almost all officials judged further rate rises likely appropriate, and CME FedWatch put the odds of a December hike near 96%. The US 10-year yield ended above 5% on 19 Nov. The October PCE inflation report, due on 25 Nov, is the last inflation read before the December meeting.
why_it_matters: Higher US rates weighed on Indian IT stocks after the minutes
Rising US yields and a firm dollar were linked to selling in metals and gold
